details.failure_summary: Known product defect #2055 - agent icon immediate-vs-persisted link check fails due to open bug
details.reasoning: The failure message explicitly states this is a 'known isolated product defect https://github.com/EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public/issues/2055, not test/infrastructure'. The test's soft assertion framework is intentionally surfacing this known bug. Core icon mutation (PUT 200), persistence after reload, save-stays-disabled, and exact-URL match all passed. The failure is tied to a tracked GitHub issue and is expected behavior until #2055 is resolved. This should be marked as KNOWN_PATTERN and linked to issue #2055.
